# Alaska Air Cargo

> Alaska Air Cargo operates 100+ destinations across North America and international routes, offering specialized cargo services including GoldStreak, Priority, and General Air Freight with live animal shipping via Pet Connect.

Alaska Air Cargo provides comprehensive air freight solutions for shippers of all sizes, from perishable seafood and dangerous goods to live animals. The platform includes real-time booking, scheduling, rate estimation, and shipment tracking across a global network.

## Core Services & Booking

- [Serving Alaska. And Beyond. Book, Track, Manage Shipments | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com): Alaska Air Cargo homepage with 100+ destinations across US, Canada, Mexico
- [Services | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/services): Shipping services overview: GoldStreak, Priority, General Air Freight
- [Freighter Schedule | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/freighter-schedule): Current Alaska Air Cargo freighter schedule and flight search tool
- [Rates & Estimates | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/services/rates): Rate calculator and pricing estimates for all Alaska Air Cargo services
- [How to Use our Booking System | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/how-to-use-our-booking-system): Booking system guide with IBS iCargo Portal and shipment management

## Network & Cargo Coverage

- [Network and Cargo Locations | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/network-locations): Cargo network directory with 100+ destinations and station information

- [Fleet and Capacity | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/fleet-and-capacity): Fleet specifications: Boeing 737-700F/800F, 787-9 capacity and dimensions

## Pet Connect Animal Shipping

- [Pet Connect Animal Travel | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/petconnect): Pet Connect live animal shipping service with policies and requirements
- [How to Transport Your Pet | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/petconnect/how-to-transport): Pet transportation step-by-step guide with health certificates and kennels
- [Pet Connect Kennels and Containers | Alaska Air Cargo](https://public.alaskacargo.com/petconnect/kennel-requirements): Pet Connect kennel specifications and container requirements for live animals
